summary: Diff adds PWA assets (manifest + sw.js), a service worker registration utility, capability detection/messaging, and a queue + background-sync request path from the live location hook. However, evidence is insufficient that the service worker is actually registered from the React entry flow, that periodic/closed-UI background sync is fully wired end-to-end, and that all required copy/transparency policy statements were updated as specified. Several unrelated UI/i18n/theming changes also appear in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Register a service worker from the React app entry flow (without modifying immutable paths).
missing_requirements.reason: A registration utility was added (registerServiceWorker.ts) but the diff summary does not show it being invoked from the React entry (e.g., src/main.tsx/App.tsx).
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (mentions frontend/src/App.tsx but does not mention SW registration)

missing_requirements.requirement: Use a background-capable mechanism (e.g., service worker + background/periodic sync) to queue and/or submit location updates when Live Location Sharing is enabled, including when UI is closed where supported.
missing_requirements.reason: The hook queues failed submissions to localStorage and requests a one-off Background Sync tag, but the service worker’s sync handler only logs updates and contains placeholder comments instead of actually submitting them to the backend. Also, periodic sync registration is implemented in the utility but not shown as being requested/used when live sharing is enabled.

missing_requirements.requirement: Fallback behavior and a clear status/notice on browsers that do not support background/periodic sync.
missing_requirements.reason: Capability detection + messaging functions were added, but the diff summary does not conclusively show the fallback/status notice being surfaced in the UI in all required cases (ChildCheckIn is truncated before showing where capabilityMessage is rendered).

missing_requirements.requirement: Update specific Live Location Sharing English copy (e.g., liveLocationActiveInfo, liveLocationForegroundNote, parent-side live sharing description) so it no longer claims sharing only works while the app is open.
missing_requirements.reason: Translation files are modified but truncated; the diff summary does not show the referenced keys/strings being updated, so this cannot be verified from provided evidence.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update pt-BR translations to match the new meaning.
missing_requirements.reason: pt-BR translation file is truncated and does not show the relevant live-location strings being updated, so completion cannot be confirmed from the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update Transparency & Policies content so it does not incorrectly state the app 'Does NOT collect data in the background' when background live sharing is enabled by the child.
missing_requirements.reason: The actual Transparency & Policies page/content changes are not shown in the diff summary (only a high-level file summary entry exists, without the specific statement change). Therefore it’s not verifiable that the incorrect claim was removed/updated.

hallucinated_features.description: App-wide i18n expansion/translation refactors across many pages (parent dashboard, child home, admin panel, schedule editor, etc.).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only requires copy updates related to live location sharing and transparency/policies; broad translation coverage changes are not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Theme-token-based styling and theme toggle related UI adjustments.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not part of the requested background live location/PWA/copy scope.

hallucinated_features.description: Service worker asset caching/offline fetch handling for '/', '/index.html', and logo asset.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-2 asks for PWA support and SW registration/sync attempts; offline caching strategy is not explicitly requested (though it may be incidental to PWA).

hallucinated_features.description: Parent location view enhancements: last-update age calculation and stale update warnings.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not explicitly requested by requirements/AC (copy/limitations notice is requested, but this monitoring UX is additional).
